_comment: Laptop test server (START.command / bin/start-msite.sh). Same as config.json plus: keeps more models loaded, and saves the last 50 test recordings + results to build/debug-audio (on this machine only) so problems can be reproduced. Do not use this file on a shared server.

local._comment: Free provider: runs the same tier-2 packs as the app, on the server. Override packs per language here; defaults come from sdkConfig.
local._packs: Laptop/server defaults: Hindi/Urdu → Dolphin small (accurate + fast on a laptop); English → Whisper base.en; others → Omnilingual (from voice-config). Run the accuracy test in the test site (/m) to compare every installed model on your own voice; whisper-turbo-int8 is the most accurate but ~10x slower.
